sentences.text:
T h i s is the second bail application filed on behalf of the applicant/accused under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail in connection with Crime No.351/2023, registered at Police Station-Kotwali Katni District-Katni (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467,
468 & 471 of Indian Penal Code.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant was granted conditional bail on deposit of Rs.94 Lacs before CJM Katni.
It is submitted that applicant is unable to deposit the said amount, therefore, he surrendered before the Court on 04.10.2023.
It is submitted that applicant is Proprietor of AB Various Services.

Applicant has sent a forged letter of Health Minister and forged document tender on mobile phone of complainants-Rupesh Saraogi, Siddharth Khard,
Aditya Gangrade and asked them for financial help.
He obtained Rs.94 Lacs on different dates from them and executed agreement dated 05.04.2023.

sentences.text: 1 learnt that no govt. tender has been issued by Health Ministry and offences were registered against applicant.
It is submitted that father of applicant had deposited Rs.10 Lacs.
Applicant has filed an application for modification of order but same was also dismissed by this Court on 06.09.2023.
It is submitted that the case is not of embezzlement of public fund.
There is no material to establish the offences under Section 467, 468, 471 of IPC.
Applicant has not forged any document, which purports to be a valuable security or a will.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3 . Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail and submitted that offence is serious in nature and is punishable with life imprisonment.
In these circumstances, she may not be released on anticipatory bail.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
5 .
As per prosecution case, applicant-Arjit Varma is Director of AB Various Services Firm.
A forged document of Health Minister was prepared and a forged Govt. tender was shown to complainant by applicant.
On the basis of same, he had obtained loan amount from complainants.
Amount of Rs.94 Lacs was paid to him and applicant has entered into an Ikrarnama and has given some cheques to complainant.
Complainants have been cheated of Rs.94 Lacs on the basis of forged documents.
Forging of Govt. tender to obtain loan is a valuable security and it cannot be said that no offence under Section 467 is made out against applicant.
Offence is punishable with life imprisonment.
White collar crime has been committed by applicant.
6. Considering the aforesaid circumstances, bail application filed by the applicant is dismissed.
